about: The Microsoft Entra app registrations TenantKeep On-Call signs in through, and the delegated permissions it asks each one for: Microsoft Graph permissions in scopes, a scope the registration defines itself in ownScopes, and a permission on another Microsoft service, written with the service in front, in serviceScopes. Published for the consent page and for TenantKeep Posture, which shares the read registration. A test in LAPSlockKit holds this file and the app's code together. For the read registration, the list is On-Call's share: TenantKeep Posture may hold further read permissions on it. For writes an organization approves either the separate registrations it wants or the one named TenantKeep Actions, which holds all of them; where both are approved the separate one is used. TenantKeep App Protection is only for an organization that applies an Intune app protection policy to the app.

registrations.name: TenantKeep
registrations.summary: Reads devices, sign-ins, policies, service health and security incidents, and reveals Windows LAPS passwords and BitLocker recovery keys. It cannot change anything.

registrations.name: TenantKeep Actions
registrations.summary: Every action in one app: role activation, device actions, user actions, account recovery and group membership. Approve this one, or the separate apps for the actions you want.

registrations.name: TenantKeep Role Activation
registrations.summary: Activates the roles and group memberships you are eligible for, and approves or denies requests.

registrations.name: TenantKeep Device Actions
registrations.summary: Syncs, restarts, locks, locates, retires and wipes devices, rotates keys and passwords, and reads a Mac's admin password.

registrations.name: TenantKeep User Actions
registrations.summary: Revokes sessions, blocks or unblocks sign-in, and confirms or dismisses a user's risk.

registrations.name: TenantKeep Account Recovery
registrations.summary: Removes a person's sign-in methods and issues a Temporary Access Pass.

registrations.name: TenantKeep Alerts
registrations.summary: Registers a phone to receive Instant alerts. It has no access to Microsoft Graph.

registrations.name: TenantKeep App Protection
registrations.summary: Lets your organization's Intune app protection policy apply to TenantKeep on a phone that is not enrolled. It has no access to Microsoft Graph.
